_comment: Reviewable draft of the eigen.beam Railway template. Railway multi-service templates are dashboard-hosted objects and cannot currently be imported from this file. Reproduce this snapshot in the template editor, test it, and keep both copies aligned.
name: eigen.beam
description: Mobile live-sync presentations with durable Postgres data, private S3-compatible asset storage and real magic-link email delivery.

eigen-beam-assets.name: eigen-beam-assets
eigen-beam-assets._comment: Private Railway Bucket. Railway exposes BUCKET, ENDPOINT, REGION, ACCESS_KEY_ID and SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for the references on the app service. The deployment region is selected in Railway.

NODE_ENV.description: Enables eigen.beam's fail-closed production configuration checks. Leave as-is.

ORIGIN.description: Public HTTPS origin used for CSRF checks and absolute magic-link URLs. Pre-wired to the Railway domain; replace it when attaching a custom domain.

EB_DECK_STORE.description: Stores decks in Postgres so they survive deploys. Leave as-is.

EB_ACTIVITY_STORE.description: Stores replay sessions, events and follows in Postgres. Leave as-is.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private Postgres connection string supplied by the attached Postgres service. Leave as-is.

EB_ASSET_STORE.description: Stores uploaded slide images in the attached Railway Bucket. Leave as-is.

EB_BUCKET_ENDPOINT.description: S3 API endpoint supplied by the Railway Bucket. Leave as-is.

EB_BUCKET_NAME.description: Globally unique S3 bucket name supplied by Railway. Leave as-is.

EB_BUCKET_REGION.description: S3 region supplied by the Railway Bucket. Leave as-is.

EB_BUCKET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Access key supplied by the Railway Bucket. This is not an AWS account key; leave the reference as-is.

EB_BUCKET_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret access key supplied by the Railway Bucket. Leave the reference as-is.

EB_BUCKET_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Uses the virtual-hosted URL style required by current Railway Buckets. Confirm this against the bucket Credentials tab.

EB_MAIL_PROVIDER.description: Sends account magic links through Resend. Leave as-is for this template.

EB_RESEND_API_KEY.description: Required Resend API key used to deliver magic-link and follow emails. Provide this during deployment.

EB_MAIL_FROM.description: Required sender, for example eigen.beam <no-reply@example.com>. Verify the sender domain at Resend before deploying or magic-link delivery will fail.

EB_MAGIC_LINK_SECRET.description: Auto-generated 32-byte hexadecimal secret for magic links, sessions, PIN cookies and signed anonymous creator IDs. Keep it stable and secret.

EB_MCP_TOKEN.description: Auto-generated bearer token that keeps the remote MCP endpoint fail-closed. Keep it secret; rotate deliberately.

EB_MIGRATE_ON_BOOT.description: Applies pending Postgres migrations before the app starts. Leave true for the one-click deployment.

Postgres.name: Postgres
Postgres._comment: Snapshot of Railway's managed Postgres template contract. In the dashboard, add Railway's Postgres database resource so Railway owns its persistent volume and lifecycle, then confirm these generated variables.

PGDATA.description: Directory used by the managed Postgres volume. Leave as-is.

PGHOST.description: Private Railway hostname for Postgres. Leave as-is.

PGUSER.description: Database user copied from POSTGRES_USER. Leave as-is.

PGDATABASE.description: Database name copied from POSTGRES_DB. Leave as-is.

PGPASSWORD.description: Database password copied from POSTGRES_PASSWORD. Leave as-is.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Database password generated once when the template is deployed. Keep it secret.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private connection string consumed by the eigen.beam service. Leave as-is.

DATABASE_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public connection string for operator backups and diagnostics. Do not expose it.

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Validity period for the database service's self-signed certificate.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period for a clean Postgres shutdown during redeploys.
